description: In x_sig.rs, SIG_HEADER is declared pub(crate) with #[allow(dead_code)] and annotated 'available for external use (e.g. test harnesses that construct signed articles)'. If no production code uses it, the allow(dead_code) attribute and the pub(crate) visibility serve only to suppress the compiler warning for a symbol that is only referenced in the test module. Either make it #[cfg(test)] pub(crate) or actually use it from production code. The current state is a contradiction: the doc says 'external use' but allow(dead_code) says the compiler disagrees.
title: verify: x_sig SIG_HEADER constant has allow(dead_code) — pub(crate) but only used in tests
